stem: In right triangle \(ABC\), the measure of angle \(A\) is \(60^{\circ}\) and \(BC = 9\). What is the length of hypotenuse \(\overline{AB}\)?

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(AC\), the leg adjacent to the \(60^{\circ}\) angle, not the hypotenuse.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This doubles 9 as if \(\overline{BC}\) were the shorter leg; \(\overline{BC}\) is opposite the \(60^{\circ}\) angle, so it is the longer leg.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(9 \sin 60^{\circ}\); the leg should be divided by \(\sin 60^{\circ}\), not multiplied.

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'C': 'A', 'A': 'B', 'D': 'C', 'B': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'C', 'B': 'A', 'C': 'D', 'D': 'B'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(d('B','C')-9)<0.01 and abs(ang('B','A','C')-60)<0.1 and abs(ang('A','C','B')-90)<0.1
ans=9/sin(pi/3)
assert abs(d('A','B')-ans)<0.01
assert simplify(value(choices[answer])-ans)==0
assert all(simplify(value(choices[k])-ans)!=0 for k in choices if k!=answer)
